title: CFTC Orders Former White House Employee to Pay $172,000 for Prediction Market Insider Trading
summary:

The post CFTC Orders Former White House Employee to Pay $172,000 for Prediction Market Insider Trading appeared first on The Daily Hodl.
content: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission has ordered a former White House employee to pay a fine following charges of insider trading. The individual allegedly misappropriated advance knowledge of presidential speeches to trade event contracts on a prediction market platform, generating more than $107,500 in illicit profits.
